chemistry-killer-06.material:
Di colour change range of indicators na as follows.
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 red, 3.1 ~ 4.4 orange, pH > 4.4 yellow
BTB: pH < 6.0 yellow, 6.0 ~ 7.6 green, pH > 7.6 blue
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 colourless, 8.3 ~ 10.0 pink, pH > 10.0 red
Di following na di result wey dem drop each of di three indicators inside three everyday aqueous solutions.
(I) Model stomach acid: methyl orange red, BTB yellow, phenolphthalein colourless
(II) Solution wey dem react with enough antacid: methyl orange yellow, BTB yellow, phenolphthalein colourless
(III) Dilute sodium hydrogen carbonate solution: methyl orange yellow, BTB blue, phenolphthalein colourless
Wen you determine di narrowest pH range wey satisfy all di results of di three indicators, which one correctly match, in order, di pH range of (I), (II) and (III)?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.prompt:
Di colour change range of indicators na as follows.
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 red, 3.1 ~ 4.4 orange, pH > 4.4 yellow
BTB: pH < 6.0 yellow, 6.0 ~ 7.6 green, pH > 7.6 blue
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 colourless, 8.3 ~ 10.0 pink, pH > 10.0 red
Di following na di result wey dem drop each of di three indicators inside three everyday aqueous solutions.
(I) Model stomach acid: methyl orange red, BTB yellow, phenolphthalein colourless
(II) Solution wey dem react with enough antacid: methyl orange yellow, BTB yellow, phenolphthalein colourless
(III) Dilute sodium hydrogen carbonate solution: methyl orange yellow, BTB blue, phenolphthalein colourless
Wen you determine di narrowest pH range wey satisfy all di results of di three indicators, which one correctly match, in order, di pH range of (I), (II) and (III)?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.explain:
(I): methyl orange red pH < 3.1, BTB yellow pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein colourless pH < 8.3. Common range pH < 3.1.
(II): methyl orange yellow pH > 4.4, BTB yellow pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein colourless pH < 8.3. Common range 4.4 < pH < 6.0.
(III): methyl orange yellow pH > 4.4, BTB blue pH > 7.6, phenolphthalein colourless pH < 8.3. Common range 7.6 < pH < 8.3.
Answer: (I) pH < 3.1, (II) 4.4 < pH < 6.0, (III) 7.6 < pH < 8.3 (b). (Wrong answers: to take (I) as di orange range 3.1 ~ 4.4 confuse red with orange, to take (II) as 6.0 ~ 7.6 confuse BTB yellow with green, and di last option use di range of only one indicator, BTB, so e no be di narrowest range)
